criteria.name: docs/design/mcp-cards.md exists with eight required sections
criteria.evidence: File exists at docs/design/mcp-cards.md. Contains all eight required sections: Problem statement (lines 5-8), URI scheme (lines 9-23), Server responsibilities (lines 25-32), Consumption by tick.sh (lines 34-41), Relationship to filesystem-is-the-message-bus (lines 43-45), Multi-machine implications (lines 47-49), Migration path (lines 51-53), Smallest-possible-prototype card outline (lines 55-62).

criteria.name: Relationship to filesystem-is-the-message-bus section reaches explicit conclusion
criteria.evidence: Section at lines 43-45 explicitly concludes: 'Conclusion: MCP-served cards refine card delivery; the filesystem remains the message bus for everything the agents emit.' This is a clear 'refinement' position with reasoning.

criteria.name: URI scheme is concrete with literal example
criteria.evidence: URI scheme defined at lines 13-14: 'stage://<repo>/<stage-id>@<version>'. Literal example at line 20: 'stage://autometta/22-mcp-served-cards-design@30faa66'.

criteria.name: Fallback-to-filesystem path described for tick.sh patching
criteria.evidence: Lines 36-41 describe the helper `scripts/resolve-card.sh` with two-path logic: MCP transport reads via resources/read and writes to /tmp/autometta-card-<stage-id>.md; any failure (server down, timeout, unknown URI) falls back to existing `stage_card_for_id`. Explicitly states 'The fallback is not optional. A failed MCP resolution must never stall a stage; it degrades to the filesystem path that works today.'

criteria.name: Smallest-possible-prototype card outline fits on one page and is liftable
criteria.evidence: Lines 55-62 present a concise prototype outline with Objective, Deliverables (5 items), Acceptance (4 testable criteria), and Out of scope (4 items). Fits within ~10 lines of structured content, clearly liftable to a future implementation card.

criteria.name: memory/decision-mcp-cards.md follows decision-memo format and links to decision-sweep-stage
criteria.evidence: File memory/decision-mcp-cards.md does not exist in the working tree. git status shows no such file; ls memory/ confirms only .gitkeep present. Required deliverable missing.

criteria.name: docs/philosophy.md edit ≤3 lines, additive only
criteria.evidence: docs/philosophy.md shows no changes in git diff. The required additive edit (≤3 lines adding MCP-cards as 'considered, deferred' under load-bearing beliefs) is absent.

criteria.name: Total prose under 1500 words
criteria.evidence: Word count of docs/design/mcp-cards.md is approximately 520 words. Even with the missing decision memo (0 words) and philosophy edit (0 words), total is well under 1500 words.

criteria.name: No em dashes; no banned vocabulary
criteria.evidence: Scanned docs/design/mcp-cards.md: no em dashes (—) found; no instances of 'delve', 'leverage', 'seamless', 'robust', 'crucial', 'pivotal'. British English spelling observed (e.g., 'behaviour', 'authored').

criteria.name: No code change; all scripts byte-identical
criteria.evidence: git status shows only docs/design/mcp-cards.md as new file. No modifications to scripts/, bin/, or any schema files. All code files remain byte-identical to HEAD.

additional_findings: Two of three deliverables are missing: memory/decision-mcp-cards.md does not exist, and docs/philosophy.md has not been edited. The design document itself (criterion 1) is well-structured and meets all its section requirements. The missing deliverables are mandatory per the Deliverables list (items 2 and 3).
